remarks: A head start on your dream home. This 1,400 sq ft bungalow sits on a big lot close to the Kennedale Ravine, with four bedrooms, a finished basement and an oversized insulated double garage. The main floor renovation has been started and is waiting for you or your contractor to finish. You choose the layout and the finishes, and the equity you build is yours. Downstairs there is a family room, a den and a fourth bedroom. The primary bedroom opens onto a big two-tier deck overlooking a private backyard with mature trees and room for a garden or fire pit. The rooms are a good size, so once the main floor is done you will have plenty of space to live in. The garage makes a great workshop, the ravine and walking trails are a short walk away, and schools, parks, shopping and transit are all close by in an established neighbourhood. Picture it finished: room for the whole family to spread out, friends over on the deck, and a home that is exactly the way you want it. Come and take a look. An amazing opportunity. (id:67522)
